Autonomous login-gated capture (self-register burner)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sites SITES         Comma-separated site names (overrides --provisioning
                        filter)
  --provisioning PROVISIONING
                        Comma-separated provisioning classes to attempt
  --max-tasks-per-site MAX_TASKS_PER_SITE
  --max-sites MAX_SITES
  --parallel PARALLEL
  --traj-dir TRAJ_DIR
  --config CONFIG
  --retry-blocked       Re-attempt sites already marked needs_human (default:
                        skip them)
